title.value: Graph Attention Networks with Positional Embeddings
title.justification: The title explicitly mentions the focus of the paper, which is the integration of positional embeddings in Graph Attention Networks (GATs).
title.quote: Graph Attention Networks with Positional Embeddings

analysis.description: This paper introduces a framework called Graph Attention Networks with Positional Embeddings (GAT-POS), which enhances the Graph Attention Networks (GATs) by integrating positional embeddings. These embeddings capture the structural and positional information of the nodes in the graph, improving GATs' performance on non-homophilic graph datasets. The framework trains jointly on the tasks of node classification and graph context prediction, achieving superior results compared to existing baselines, especially on non-homophilic datasets.

type.justification: The paper presents experimental results showing the performance improvement of GAT-POS over other models on both non-homophilic and homophilic datasets.
type.quote: Experimental results show that GAT-POS reaches remarkable improvement compared to strong GNN baselines and recent structural embedding enhanced GNNs on non-homophilic graphs.
